name: dmb
description: This is an Unraid Docker template for: Debrid Media Bridge This project is now considered deprecated. Future efforts will be directed at Debrid Media Unlimited Bridge (DUMB) This template will therefore not receieve any further updates. I recommend checking out DUMB! Debrid Media Bridge (DMB) is an All-In-One (AIO) docker image for the unified deployment of the following projects/tools: cli_debrid, dmbdb, Decypharr, pgAdmin4, phalanx_db, plex_debrid, PostgreSQL, rclone, Riven, Zilean, Zurg https://github.com/I-am-PUID-0/DMB#-projects-included

paths.name: rclone config directory
paths.description: Directory where your rclone config file will be stored.

paths.name: log directory
paths.description: Directory where your DMB logs will be found.

paths.name: Real-debrid directory
paths.description: Directory for Real-Debrid config related files. These are used by the Zurg rclone mount of your Real-Debrid webDAV (read support documents for more info)

paths.name: PostgreSQL directory
paths.description: Directory for the postgreSQL database files used with DMB.

paths.name: Zurg rclone mount -- ADD THIS DIRECTORY TO Plex/Jellyfin/Emby!
paths.description: MUST BE 'Read/Write - Shared'!!! You must add the full host path above to your plex container. DO NOT ADD THIS AS A LIBRARY! ONLY ADD THE PATH TO PLEX! THAT'S ALL!

paths.name: Riven symlink mount directory -- ADD THIS DIRECTORY TO Plex/Jellyfin/Emby!
paths.description: Directory for the riven symlinks. This directory is where Plex/Jellyfin/Emby will be looking to see your shows/movies! ADD THIS DIRECTORY TO Plex/Jellyfin/Emby! ADD IT AS A LIBRARY! eg in Plex it would be a library to '/mnt/movies' and '/mnt/shows'

paths.name: Zilean Data Path
paths.description: Ziilean is highly recommended to grab high quality cached torrent lists!

paths.name: Zilean wwwroot path
paths.description: Maybe not required. Added because the container wasn't creating it automatically and causing errors.

paths.name: PGAdmin data directory
paths.description: Data directory for PGAdmin. Optional tool for managing the PostgreSQL database.

paths.name: cli_debrid Data
paths.description: Optional. Similiar to plex_debrid. Read: https://github.com/godver3/cli_debrid

paths.name: Phalanx Database
paths.description: Optional. Recommended if using cli_debrid. Read: https://github.com/godver3/phalanx_db_hyperswarm

ports.name: PGAdmin 4 Port
ports.description: Optional. Needed for running PGAdmin in non-host network mode. Port for pgAdmin 4. Can be removed if you aren't using pgAdmin. Host port number can be changed if required. Keep container port 5050.

ports.name: DMB Frontend Port
ports.description: Only needed if running in non-host network. If running in Host network mode, this can be deleted

ports.name: Riven webUI port
ports.description: This is the port the Riven webUI will show up on.

ports.name: Decypharr Port
ports.description: This is the port the Decypharr webUI will show up on.

variables.name: ORIGIN
variables.description: origin URL http:// :[port] format No trailing slash!

variables.name: Real-Debrid API Key
variables.description: https://real-debrid.com/apitoken Enter your real-debrid token from the link. Keep this token/key SAFE! Treat it as you would a password. If others obtain it, they can access your real-debrid account.

variables.name: DMB Log Level
variables.description: Set this to DEBUG for extensive info for ex troubleshooting. Can be set to NOTICE for less info in the log.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: Set the system PID. unraid uses nobody:users (99:100). docker should match the OS if possible. recommended to not change this unless you have a reason.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Set the system PGID. unraid uses nobody:users (99:100). docker should match the OS if possible. recommended to not change this unless you have a reason.

devices.name: Access Host OS fuse
devices.description: Path to docker fuse on the unraid host. Has to be included otherwise fuser fails to mount.
